title: GWD Intelligence & Knowledge Galaxy
subtitle: A governed architecture of organizational knowledge, structured vaults, memory layers and capability constellations.
disclaimer: Visual metaphors of constellations, nodes and synapses illustrate GWD's proposed knowledge architecture. They do not imply biological consciousness, autonomous sentience or live production telemetry. Obsidian is a structured knowledge vault/interface, not the agents' runtime memory engine.

corePillars.label: GBrain · Organizational Memory Layer
corePillars.summary: Central governed intelligence and memory architecture that indexes institutional context, decisions, mission outcomes and domain knowledge.
corePillars.technicalTruth: Proposed architectural layer coordinating structured indexing, access-controlled persistence and context governance across GWD.
corePillars.naturalParallel: Long-term cortical memory integration and institutional wisdom.

corePillars.label: Knowledge Hub · Curated Institutional Corpus
corePillars.summary: Curated, human-verified repository of playbooks, policies, domain syntheses, brand standards and approved operational procedures.
corePillars.technicalTruth: Editorial and governance layer ensuring agents and human teams consult verified organizational sources rather than unverified assumptions.
corePillars.naturalParallel: Library of verified human knowledge, standards and cultural canon.

corePillars.label: Obsidian Vault · Structured Knowledge Interface
corePillars.summary: Markdown-native knowledge vault and graph authoring environment used by humans and workflows to structure interlinked notes, ADRs and domain dossiers.
corePillars.technicalTruth: Obsidian acts as the human-navigable knowledge vault and structured documentation interface — it is NOT, by itself, the runtime memory engine of the agents.
corePillars.naturalParallel: Written notebooks, cartographic atlases and cross-referenced archives.

corePillars.label: Knowledge Graph · Entity & Capability Topology
corePillars.summary: Typed network of relationships linking organizational units, capability profiles, documents, missions, risks and domain concepts.
corePillars.technicalTruth: Explicit graph relationships (reports_to, advises, provides_service_to, capability_supports and semantic topic links) enabling traceable traversal.
corePillars.naturalParallel: Synaptic pathways associating concepts, causes and relationships.

corePillars.label: Working Memory · Ephemeral Task Context
corePillars.summary: Short-lived operational context window scoped to a single bounded mission step, task execution or human-supervised session.
corePillars.technicalTruth: Ephemeral session state holding active instructions, step inputs and tool outputs; cleared or summarized upon gate completion.
corePillars.naturalParallel: Prefrontal working attention focused on an immediate task.

corePillars.label: Persistent Memory · Governed Durable State
corePillars.summary: Durable retained context subject to strict data governance, privacy rules, retention policies and human audit.
corePillars.technicalTruth: Access-controlled state store where only verified, policy-compliant lessons and artifacts are promoted after human or quality review.
corePillars.naturalParallel: Consolidated long-term episodic and procedural memory.

corePillars.label: Smart Retrieval · Context Supply & Provenance
corePillars.summary: Mechanisms that locate, rank and supply relevant, provenance-tagged context from GBrain, Knowledge Hub and Vaults to agents and teams.
corePillars.technicalTruth: Hybrid lexical, graph and vector retrieval pipelines that attach source citations and confidence boundaries to every supplied context block.
corePillars.naturalParallel: Associative recall bringing the right knowledge to mind at the right moment.

corePillars.label: Agent Identity & Context · Operational Soul
corePillars.summary: Structured role definition, domain specialization, operating rules, tool boundaries and escalation requirements for each catalogued profile.
corePillars.technicalTruth: Explicit system specification and role charter (283 source profiles across 18 divisions) — operational identity, never biological consciousness.
corePillars.naturalParallel: Professional vocation, ethical charter and specialized craft.
